evidence.eq: 『service our debt, and improve our debt leverage ratios』『interest payments on our outstanding Senior Notes, with the interest payments being due in the first and third quarters』→レバレッジ資本構成。負資本の縮小(XBRL系列)は黒字による回復
evidence.expiry: 『our contractual arrangements include neither exclusivity clauses nor commitments from our customers to order any given quantities of products on a medium or long-term basis』→特許崖・コンセッション満了・独占契約の期限いずれも該当なし=no
evidence.dom: 『we believe these efforts have resulted in CPI gaining estimated overall U.S. market share over the last several years』+『Our marketplace is highly competitive, relatively saturated and increasingly consolidated』→統合が進む寡占市場でシェア拡大中=寡占支配70(CPI単独シェアの明示値は原本になく、統合・シェア獲得から40-69%と推定。50の可能性も残す)
evidence.irr: 『neither exclusivity clauses nor commitments from our customers』+『Failure to retain existing key customers... due to competitive products, pricing pressures』→顧客は契約上ロックされず価格圧力あり=代替容易寄り50(20年関係の摩擦はdurで評価)
evidence.rep: 『highly competitive, relatively saturated and increasingly consolidated』『competition that may result in a loss of our market share』→既存競合が現存し追随可だが統合障壁で新規参入は容易でない=困難60
evidence.dur: 『one customer that accounted for... 16% of total revenue... we have been serving this customer for nearly 20 years』→長期関係(スイッチングコストの示唆)。ただし無独占契約+『pricing pressures』で侵食され得る型=55
evidence.geopol: 『certain components are only available from a single supplier, or substituting a component from a different supplier may require additional time and investment』+『our general procurement philosophy is to prevent or avoid being dependent on a single-source supplier』→単一供給部材リスクは存在するが緩和方針あり、単一地域製造依存ではない。関税/顧客集中はgeopol対象外(field定義=物理的・構造的毀損のみ、市場制限はcagr/f2・顧客集中はf3で評価)=0
evidence.erosion: 『highly competitive, relatively saturated and increasingly consolidated』『pricing pressures』の圧力下だが『gaining estimated overall U.S. market share』で大口離反の明示なし=兆候ありemerging
evidence.disrupt: 蝕セクションのヒットは競争・価格圧力のみで技術代替(モバイルウォレット/デジタル化)の直接キーワードなし。物理決済カードの長期デジタル代替は業界文脈上未決=unsettled(直接hits弱く文脈判断)
evidence.moatdecay: 『gaining estimated overall U.S. market share』『increased volumes of contactless cards』→明確な堀崩壊なし=no
evidence.p4: material weaknessヒットはリスク要因『We have identified material weaknesses and significant deficiencies in our internal controls in the past and we may identify additional material weaknesses』(過去の存在と将来可能性の開示)と監査手続の定型文であり、FY2025当期の不適正ICFR意見ではない。『Unresolved Staff Comments』はItem 1B目次表記(実質None)。accr=-11.1%(<0)で現金裏付けは強いが、過去MW履歴+CEO退任+負資本により清潔な90ではなく75
evidence.f3: 『one customer that accounted for approximately 16% of total revenue... more than half of our revenue is derived from several large customers』→顧客集中は高いが2025時点で16%・20年関係で悪化の明示なし(-10不適用)。シェアは『gaining』=片方+で75
evidence.f4: 『contributions of $42.8 million, or 7.9% of revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025, from the acquisition of Arroweye』+『new segment structure... separation of our proprietary integrated technological related oper[ations], beginning in the first quarter of 2026』→隣接(オンデマンド/技術系)拡張が売上5%超で成長=80
evidence.p2: 『Payment cards are generally influenced by broader cyclical changes in the economy, with economic downturns potentially resulting in decreases in the demand』→循環性を自認。ただし唯一の明確な不況(COVID2020)は営業利益24.7→38.4百万と増益で通過。単一データ点+2018年opm1.8%(op4.6百万、業界チップカード供給過剰)の営業脆弱性実績により75止まり
